tests.name: Manually Detachable Parts Humidity Test

tests.name: Humidity Chamber Test - Units rated IPX0
tests.description: ME EQUIPMENT heated between T and T+4°C for at least 4h, placed in humidity chamber (RH 93%±3%), ambient within 2°C of T in range +20°C to +32°C for 48h for units rated IPX0

tests.name: Humidity Chamber Test - Units rated higher than IPX0
tests.description: For units rated higher than IPX0, test time extended to 168h

tests.name: Test Sequence
tests.description: Unless stated otherwise, tests in this standard sequenced as in Annex B to prevent influencing results of any subsequent test

tests.name: Determination of APPLIED PARTS and ACCESSIBLE PARTS
APPLIED PARTS Identification
tests.description: APPLIED PARTS identified by inspection and reference to ACCOMPANYING DOCUMENTS
tests.result: The probe is identified as applied parts.

tests.name: Accessibility Test - Standard Test Finger
tests.description: Accessibility determined using standard test finger of Fig 6 applied in bent or straight position

tests.name: Opening Test - Straight Un-jointed Test Finger
tests.description: Openings preventing entry of test finger of Fig. 6 mechanically tested with straight un-jointed test finger of same dimensions with force of 30 N

tests.name: Re-test with Standard Test Finger after Straight Finger Entry
tests.description: When the straight un-jointed test finger entered, test with the standard test finger (Fig 6) was repeated if necessary by pushing the finger through the opening

tests.name: Test Hook Insertion Test
tests.description: Test hook of Fig. 7 inserted in all openings of ME EQUIPMENT and pulled with a force of 20 N for 10 s

tests.name: Additional Accessible Parts Check
tests.description: All additional parts that became accessible checked using standard test finger and by inspection

requirements.description: ME EQUIPMENT or parts thereof affected by climatic conditions subjected to humidity preconditioning prior to tests of Clauses 8.7.4 and 8.8.3. Humidity preconditioning: 25°C, RH=93%, 168 hours.

semantic_fragments.content: For Clause 5.7: ME EQUIPMENT heated to a temperature between T and T+4°C for at least 4 hours and placed in a humidity chamber (relative humidity 93%±3%) with an ambient within 2°C of T in the range of +20°C to +32°C for 48 hours for units rated IPX0. For units rated higher than IPX0, test time extended to 168 hours. Manually detachable parts removed and treated concurrently with major parts; manually removable ACCESS COVERS opened and detached.
Clause 5.8: Unless stated otherwise, tests in this standard are sequenced as in Annex B to prevent influencing results of any subsequent test.

Clause 5.9.2.1: Accessibility, when necessary, determined using standard test finger of Fig 6 applied in a bent or straight position. Openings preventing entry of test finger of Fig. 6 mechanically tested with a straight un-jointed test finger of the same dimensions with a force of 30 N. When the straight un-jointed test finger entered, test with the standard test finger (Fig 6) was repeated, if necessary, by pushing the finger through the opening. Result: No opening found.

Clause 5.9.2.3: Conductive parts of actuating mechanisms of electrical controls accessible after removal of handles, knobs, levers and the like are regarded as ACCESSIBLE PARTS. However, conductive parts of actuating mechanisms are not considered ACCESSIBLE PARTS when removal of handles, knobs, etc. required the use of a TOOL. Result: No such conductive part found.

Clause 6.2: EQUIPMENT with means of connection to a SUPPLY MAINS complied with CLASS I or CLASS II ME EQUIPMENT requirements when so connected, and when not connected to SUPPLY MAINS complied with INTERNALLY POWERED ME EQUIPMENT requirements.

Clause 7.1.3: Required markings can be removed only with a TOOL or by appreciable force, are durable and remain CLEARLY LEGIBLE during EXPECTED SERVICE LIFE of ME EQUIPMENT in NORMAL USE. Test result: Can be removed only with appreciable force.
